rows.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route != '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, COUNT(*) AS drug_count, SUM(CASE WHEN dr.prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rx_only_count, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.storage_conditions) LIKE '%room temperature%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS room_temp_count FROM drug dr WHERE dr.administration_route != '' GROUP BY route_family

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%university%' THEN 'university_affiliated' WHEN LOWER(i.institution_type) LIKE '%public%' THEN 'public' WHEN i.institution_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS inst_type, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dr.prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN dr.id END) AS rx_only_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.treatments != '' THEN d.id END) AS treatment_recorded_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) JOIN institution i ON ( LOWER(TRIM(i.research_diseases)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(i.research_diseases), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE i.institution_type != '' GROUP BY inst_type

SELECT CASE WHEN prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN 'prescription_only' ELSE 'other' END AS rx_status, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug WHERE LOWER(pharmaceutical_form) LIKE '%tablet%' AND prescription_status != '' GROUP BY rx_status

SELECT CASE WHEN dr.prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN 'prescription_only' WHEN dr.prescription_status != '' THEN 'other' END AS rx_status, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.prescription_status != '' GROUP BY rx_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route != '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dr.manufacturer != '' THEN dr.id END) AS known_mfr_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.administration_route != '' AND d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY route_family, type_family HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) >= 2

SELECT CASE WHEN prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN 'prescription_only' ELSE 'other' END AS rx_status, CASE WHEN LOWER(storage_conditions) LIKE '%room temperature%' THEN 'room_temperature' ELSE 'other_storage' END AS storage_group, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug WHERE prescription_status != '' AND storage_conditions != '' GROUP BY rx_status, storage_group

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN 'infectious' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%neoplastic%' THEN 'neoplastic' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%inflammatory%' THEN 'inflammatory' WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%psychiatric%' THEN 'psychiatric' WHEN d.disease_type != '' THEN 'other' END AS type_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' AND d.disease_type != '' GROUP BY type_family

SELECT CASE WHEN prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN 'prescription_only' WHEN prescription_status != '' THEN 'other' END AS rx_status, COUNT(*) AS drug_count FROM drug WHERE prescription_status != '' GROUP BY rx_status

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(dr.administration_route) LIKE '%oral%' THEN 'oral' WHEN dr.administration_route != '' THEN 'non_oral' END AS route_family, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.id) AS drug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(d.disease_type) LIKE '%infectious%' THEN dr.id END) AS infectious_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dr.prescription_status LIKE '%prescription_only%' THEN dr.id END) AS rx_only_count FROM drug dr JOIN disease d ON ( LOWER(TRIM(dr.disease_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) OR '|' || REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(dr.disease_name), ' || ', '||'), '||', '|') || '|' LIKE '%|' || LOWER(TRIM(d.disease_name)) || '|%' ) WHERE dr.administration_route != '' GROUP BY route_family
